name: Viridian — Financial Intelligence Layer
desc: The organisational second brain for Viridian Financial Group. Captures institutional knowledge across regulatory compliance, adviser practice, firm identity, and client intelligence — making every AI tool Viridian runs distinctively and defensibly Viridian.

nodes.label: Own the Intelligence Layer
nodes.desc: Build the context foundation that every AI tool Viridian runs sits on top of. Vendor-agnostic, Viridian-owned, compounding over time. The moat is not the tools — it is what the tools know about Viridian.

nodes.label: Scale Advice Quality
nodes.desc: Under PE ownership with a growth agenda, Viridian needs every adviser — across 27 locations and future acquisitions — performing at the standard of the firm's best. The intelligence layer is how that scales without proportional headcount.

nodes.label: Defend Against CFS Edge AI
nodes.desc: CFS Edge will build a platform-native copilot. So will every major vendor. Those tools will be identical across all firms on the platform. The Viridian Intelligence Layer is what differentiates Viridian's AI from every other advice firm's AI.

nodes.label: Preserve Knowledge Through Growth
nodes.desc: M&A activity and adviser turnover are both accelerating under TA Associates ownership. Institutional knowledge that walks out the door or fails to transfer across acquired practices is a direct threat to the growth thesis.

nodes.label: Meeting Recordings
nodes.desc: Adviser-client meeting recordings transcribed via Whisper. The richest source of real advice reasoning, client context, and how Viridian's best advisers actually think in practice.

nodes.label: Iress / XPlan Records
nodes.desc: Existing client records, advice history, and SOA documents. The structured data layer that anchors client context and captures what has been advised previously.

nodes.label: CFS Edge Portfolio Data
nodes.desc: Portfolio positions, transaction history, and performance data via CFS Edge API. What clients own. The intelligence layer adds why — the reasoning and context that the platform cannot provide.

nodes.label: Compliance Documents
nodes.desc: Internal compliance policies, regulatory interpretations, approved position papers, and edge case resolutions. The regulatory knowledge corpus that currently lives in the compliance team's heads and inboxes.

nodes.label: Senior Adviser Workshops
nodes.desc: Structured extraction sessions with Viridian's most experienced advisers. Decision archaeology surfaces the mental models and heuristics that distinguish excellent advice from adequate advice.

nodes.label: Approved Advice Documents
nodes.desc: Historical SOAs and advice documents that passed compliance review. The corpus of what good Viridian advice actually looks like — the pattern library for every drafting skill.

nodes.label: Internal Communications
nodes.desc: Teams and email threads where real decisions and reasoning get captured informally. Ingestion tuned for signal — decisions and rationale — not noise.

nodes.label: ASIC Regulatory Positions
nodes.desc: Viridian's approved interpretations of ASIC guidance. Not generic regulatory information — the firm's specific positions, what has been tested, what has been approved. The difference between safe advice and generic AI output.

nodes.label: AFSL Compliance Boundaries
nodes.desc: The hard limits of what Viridian advisers can and cannot recommend under the firm's AFSL. The guardrail layer that governs every AI output that touches advice.

nodes.label: Edge Case Resolutions
nodes.desc: How Viridian has resolved complex or ambiguous regulatory situations historically. The precedent library that makes compliance Q&A grounded rather than generically plausible.

nodes.label: Best Interest Duty Application
nodes.desc: Viridian's specific interpretation and practical application of the best interest duty. How advisers demonstrate compliance — the language, the documentation, the reasoning pattern.

nodes.label: Product Approved List
nodes.desc: Current approved products and platforms with the reasoning behind inclusions and exclusions. Makes product-adjacent AI outputs compliant by default rather than requiring manual review.

nodes.label: Regulatory Change Responses
nodes.desc: How Viridian has adapted to regulatory changes over time. The pattern of response that informs how the firm should handle future changes — and what positions were taken at each shift.

nodes.label: Senior Adviser Mental Models
nodes.desc: How Viridian's top performers think through complex client situations. The heuristics, the diagnostic questions, the pattern recognition. Currently locked in individual heads. The highest-value extraction target.

nodes.label: Client Situation Frameworks
nodes.desc: How Viridian approaches different client archetypes and life stages. The structured thinking that experienced advisers apply instinctively but new advisers spend years learning.

nodes.label: Advice Construction Patterns
nodes.desc: How Viridian structures advice recommendations end-to-end. The reasoning flow from client situation to strategy to product to implementation that produces consistent, defensible advice.

nodes.label: Complex Case Precedents
nodes.desc: Anonymised examples of how Viridian has handled genuinely complex or unusual client situations. The institutional memory that prevents every complex case being solved from scratch.

nodes.label: Portfolio Construction Logic
nodes.desc: Viridian's investment philosophy in practice. How managed accounts are constructed, why specific allocations are made, what the rationale is for key positions and asset class views.

nodes.label: Objection and Concern Handling
nodes.desc: How experienced Viridian advisers respond to common client concerns, objections, and anxieties. The language and reasoning that has worked in practice across different client types.

nodes.label: Viridian Voice and Tone
nodes.desc: How Viridian communicates. The warmth, the professionalism, the specific language choices that make Viridian communications sound like Viridian rather than generic financial services advice.

nodes.label: Investment Philosophy
nodes.desc: Viridian's core beliefs about investing, risk, the role of advice, and what good financial outcomes look like. The intellectual foundation that underpins all recommendations and differentiates the firm's approach.

nodes.label: Approved Disclosure Language
nodes.desc: The exact language approved for client-facing documents — disclaimers, disclosures, standard wording. Has passed compliance review. Makes every drafted document compliant by default.

nodes.label: Strategic Positioning
nodes.desc: How Viridian positions itself — what the firm stands for, what makes it different from competitors, the narrative that shapes how advisers present the firm to clients and prospects.

nodes.label: Leadership Decision History
nodes.desc: Key strategic decisions and the reasoning behind them. The institutional memory at the leadership level that informs how new decisions should be approached consistently with the firm's direction.

nodes.label: Client Segment Patterns
nodes.desc: What Viridian's different client segments actually care about, how they think about money, what they worry about, what they value, and how they make decisions. The intelligence that makes advice feel personal.

nodes.label: Life Stage Intelligence
nodes.desc: What clients at different life stages typically need, what is top of mind, and what advice has the most impact. The context that makes pre-meeting briefings and recommendations genuinely useful.

nodes.label: HNW and Family Office Dynamics
nodes.desc: Specific intelligence around high-net-worth and family client relationships — how decisions get made, who the real influencers are, what the unstated priorities typically are.

nodes.label: Client Communication Preferences
nodes.desc: How different client types prefer to receive information. Level of detail, language complexity, format, frequency. The context that makes client communications land rather than get filed.

nodes.label: Retention and Engagement Signals
nodes.desc: What predicts client satisfaction, deepening, and retention at Viridian. The patterns that distinguish clients who stay and grow versus those who disengage — surfaced before it is too late to act.

nodes.label: Client Communication Drafter
nodes.desc: Drafts client emails, letters, and post-review summaries in Viridian's voice with correct approved language and disclaimers. Adviser provides the key points. Skill produces a first-pass draft that sounds like Viridian, not like generic AI.

nodes.label: Compliance Q&A
nodes.desc: Answers regulatory and compliance questions grounded in Viridian's approved positions with citations to source documents. Replaces slow compliance team email chains for the 80% of queries that have a clear approved answer.

nodes.label: Pre-Meeting Briefing
nodes.desc: Prepares advisers for client review meetings in seconds. Portfolio context, life events flagged, what was committed to last time, what should be raised this time. Currently takes 30-60 minutes manually per client.

nodes.label: SOA Section Drafter
nodes.desc: Drafts specific sections of Statements of Advice in Viridian's approved language — strategy rationale, risk profile summary, recommendation sections. Compliant first-pass that advisers review and personalise.

nodes.label: Meeting Summary Capture
nodes.desc: Converts meeting notes or transcripts into structured Viridian-format summaries — decisions made, actions agreed, next steps. Consistent documentation quality across all 120 advisers at 27 locations.

nodes.label: Portfolio Rationale Builder
nodes.desc: Given a portfolio position or recommendation, drafts the rationale in Viridian's language grounded in the firm's investment philosophy and current approved positions. Turns adviser thinking into defensible documentation.

nodes.label: New Adviser Onboarding
nodes.desc: Answers new adviser questions about how Viridian thinks, approaches client situations, and constructs advice. Compresses the tacit knowledge transfer that currently takes 12 months of informal mentorship.

nodes.label: Regulatory Lookup
nodes.desc: Surfaces Viridian's specific regulatory position on a topic — not generic ASIC guidance but what the firm has decided, with the reasoning, the source, and the confidence level. Full audit trail.

nodes.label: Context Owners
nodes.desc: Named owners per context layer. Compliance team owns regulatory nodes. Senior advisers own practice nodes. Marketing owns firm identity. They approve what enters the intelligence layer and are accountable for accuracy.

nodes.label: Curation Dashboard
nodes.desc: The interface where context owners review flagged interactions, approve corrections, and update knowledge nodes. One-click approve, edit, reject, or escalate. No technical knowledge required to operate.

nodes.label: Guardrails Layer
nodes.desc: What the AI can and cannot say. Hard limits on advice output, required disclaimers, escalation triggers for out-of-scope queries. Compliance-approved and fully audit-logged. The difference between safe deployment and liability.

nodes.label: Audit Trail
nodes.desc: Complete log of every AI-assisted interaction — what context was applied, what guardrail fired, what output was produced. Exportable for ASIC compliance evidence. The governance layer that makes enterprise deployment possible.

nodes.label: Compounding Feedback Loop
nodes.desc: Every adviser correction, guardrail trigger, and usefulness signal feeds back into the context pack via the curation queue. The intelligence layer gets smarter every cycle without additional consulting engagement.

nodes.label: Adviser Productivity
nodes.desc: 30 minutes saved per client interaction. Across 120 advisers running 10 reviews per week that is 600 hours reclaimed weekly — capacity that funds growth without proportional headcount increase.

nodes.label: Advice Quality Floor Raised
nodes.desc: Junior advisers across all 27 locations performing closer to senior adviser standard. The institutional knowledge that currently requires years of mentorship is available from day one.

nodes.label: Compliance Risk Reduced
nodes.desc: Fewer breaches from inconsistent regulatory interpretation. Every adviser output grounded in Viridian's approved positions with a complete audit trail. Demonstrable compliance posture for ASIC.

nodes.label: Knowledge Retention Through Growth
nodes.desc: Institutional knowledge preserved through adviser departures and acquisitions. The TA Associates growth thesis protected — every firm acquired inherits Viridian's intelligence layer not just its brand.

nodes.label: Onboarding Accelerated
nodes.desc: New adviser time to productive independence reduced from 12 months toward 3-4 months. Material improvement in growth economics and retention for advisers who reach capability faster.

nodes.label: Competitive Differentiation
nodes.desc: Every CFS Edge firm gets the same platform AI. Viridian gets an intelligence layer built from 10 years of institutional knowledge that competitors cannot replicate by signing up to the same vendor tomorrow.
